deploy-bot: Rollout initiated: release=v3.3.0 rollout=staged traffic=15% route=/chat id=r-1765123456

SRE-bot: Baseline checks running: p95, p99, 5xx, mem RSS, kv-cache hitrate. Alerts will post to this thread.

Omar: Agreed. Also stop on repeated "segfault" logs in model worker. Set manual stop ready.

SRE-bot: ALERT r-1765123456: kv-cache miss rate = 12% (3m). Top log: "kvcache: eviction pressure high" on node infra-c-07.

Priya: Requesting manual STOP. Rolling back traffic to v3.2.9 and draining canary pods.

deploy-bot: STOP requested by @Priya. Executing rollback steps:
route set /chat --version=3.2.9
scale deployment llm-chat-v3.3.0 --replicas=0
label nodes infra-c-07 evict=true

Maya: Confirmed stop. Opening bug tracker T-9902 for kv-cache regression, owners @Priya and @Omar. Scheduling postmortem 2026-04-01 03:30 UTC.

Omar: I'll grab cache telemetry and heap snapshots before the sync. Thanks for the quick reaction. :thumbsup:
